about: Authoritative Food Nearby venue catalog, curated from official UCSD sources. Static, not live. Unknown values are null, never guessed. Wallet eligibility follows the official listings: HDH venues accept Dining Dollars and Triton Cash; listed Triton Cash partners accept Triton Cash and not Dining Dollars (HDH only).

venues.name: 64 Degrees
venues.summary: Burritos, sushi, burgers and milkshakes across six stations.
venues.description: Good mood food (think burritos, sushi, burgers and milkshakes), private relaxation rooms, outdoor lounge space, and our Food Lab where you can learn how to make our culinary team’s favorite meals! Offering a modern vibe, choose from six stations featuring Triton Grill, Wok This Way, Taqueria, Garden Bar, al Dente and our new Sushi bar UMI.

dining_dollars.reason: HDH dining and market locations accept Dining Dollars.

triton_cash.reason: Triton Cash is accepted at HDH Dining Services locations.

venues.name: Bistro
venues.summary: Pacific Rim-inspired menu with a sushi bar and noodle dishes.
venues.description: A modern eatery featuring an open kitchen, sushi bar, and an exciting Pacific Rim-inspired menu. Our chefs draw from various Asian cultures to serve up the freshest seafood, crisp greens, local produce inspired vegetarian fare, and noodle dishes.

dining_dollars.reason: HDH dining and market locations accept Dining Dollars.

triton_cash.reason: Triton Cash is accepted at HDH Dining Services locations.

venues.name: Canyon Vista Marketplace
venues.summary: Halal-certified dining with grill, fresh and coffee stations, plus a market.
venues.description: Canyon Vista Marketplace is the largest halal-certified residential dining facility in the nation. Canyon Vista Marketplace features menus designed around our Rooted in Flavor principles of healthy, sustainable meals. Stations include Fusion Grill, Fresh, Three-Sixty and Earl's Coffee House. Shop for groceries, snacks, grab and go and household items at Marketplace.

venues.summary: Personal pizzas, salads, a sandwich bar and grill specials.
venues.description: Enjoy personal pizzas made to order, fresh garden salads, and a sandwich bar. You can also find snacks and grocery staples to prepare your own meals. Join us on the patio for grill specials including tacos, burgers, steak and salmon.

venues.description: This fifth-floor restaurant offers a delightful culinary experience with Mediterranean specialties, stone-fired pizzas, pasta bakes, sandwiches, and salads. Indulge in fresh-baked desserts and coffee while enjoying beautiful ocean views from our patio.

venues.summary: Plant-based entrees, poke, noodles, global street food and BBQ.
venues.description: The Restaurants at Sixth College encompass five exciting and unique platforms as well as the largest retail market on campus. Enjoy plant-based entrees, poke bowls, all kinds of noodles, global street food, BBQ, and so much more!

venues.name: Ventanas
venues.summary: African Diaspora-inspired platforms: Caribbean, African, soul food, hand pies, Indian and coffee.
venues.description: Breathtaking architectural design includes 30-foot glass walls, open natural wood beam ceilings, and a large outdoor dining patio and amphitheater. Featuring multiple Food Platforms dedicated to cuisine inspired by the African Diaspora. Enjoy Caribbean specials at Vibe, a taste of Africa at Journey, Delicious Soul Food at Soul, Hand Pies from around the world at Hapi and Indian Cuisine from Tandoor, or Coffee from our Coffee House Kaldi.
